title: Your first conversation with an AI assistant: what to type, and what comes back

posts.facebook:
Talk to an AI assistant the way you would brief a helpful stranger: who you are, what you want, then answer back.

A first-timer's guide to AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and Gemini: what you need to start, how a conversation differs from a search, how to ask so the answer is useful, and five ready-to-type first requests. It also covers what not to type in, why answers need checking, and where to learn alongside other people.

Open one free assistant, tell it who you are and what you want in full sentences, then reply to its answer until it is useful.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/ai/your-first-conversation-with-an-ai-assistant/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
